claim: A covariance-aware predictive shield can preserve useful control while preventing boundary violations under delayed, missing, amplified, saturated, and sign-reversed actuation.

policies.supervisor: uncertainty stop plus velocity cap and one-step worst-case boundary shield

falsification: Any supervised boundary violation, failure to outperform zero action, no actual shield intervention, or a locked-test threshold miss falsifies this version.
cost_policy: NumPy-only deterministic sandbox; physical robots, paid APIs, and neuroimaging acquisition are SKIPPED_COST.
